info.title: agentsd: folders
info.description: The host methods of the folders group; see daemon.openrpc.json for the rest of the document.

methods.name: artifact/write
methods.description: Write a file an agent may read, whole (#415). With `base`, refused with fileChanged when the file changed on disk since the edit began (#1858), so nobody's change is written over unseen.

methods.name: browser/clear
methods.description: Clear the cookies and site data of one site, or of every site, in the machine's browser's kept profile (#3535). The person's own clients only.

methods.name: browser/frame
methods.description: A frame of the machine's browser's page (#3528), to each client that watches it.

methods.name: browser/input
methods.description: The person's click, scroll, key or paste in the machine's browser's page (#3528).

methods.name: browser/navigate
methods.description: Back, Forward, Reload or an address in the machine's browser (#3528).

methods.name: browser/pageChanged
methods.description: The machine's browser started, stopped, failed or moved to another page (#3528), to each client that watches it.

methods.name: browser/state
methods.description: Settings ▸ Browser (#3535): the machine's browser's download and the sites its kept profile has cookies for. It starts Chromium to read them when it is downloaded and not running. The person's own clients only.

methods.name: browser/unwatch
methods.description: The client stops watching the machine's browser (#3528). The host also stops when the connection ends.

methods.name: browser/watch
methods.description: The client watches the machine's browser (#3528, spike #3527): the host sends browser/frame and browser/pageChanged to it until browser/unwatch. It starts nothing: browser/navigate with go does.

methods.name: browserControl/set
methods.description: Set the browser for this machine: Ask, Always Approve or Off (#4264). Refused notPermitted from any caller but the person's own clients: never an agent, an MCP tool or a workflow.

methods.name: browserControl/state
methods.description: The browser for this machine (#4264): when never set, Ask on a machine a person uses and Always Approve on one only agents use.

methods.name: changes/undoTurn
methods.description: Put the files a turn changed back as they were before it (#3437), from the snapshot the host took as the turn began. Refused while the agent's turn runs.

methods.name: desktopControl/liveFrame
methods.description: The live tile's frame (#3004, US4, FR-011): sent to the clients showing an agent that holds the screen lease, after each drive_screen action and at least every 5 seconds while it is idle. Locked and no image while the Mac's screen is locked (FR-012). Never recorded.

methods.name: desktopControl/resume
methods.description: Let an agent paused by the person's touch drive again (#3004, US3): its drive_screen goes on from where it stopped. Refused notPaused when it is not paused; refused notPermitted from any caller but the person's own clients.

methods.name: desktopControl/set
methods.description: Set desktop control for this Mac: Ask, Always Approve or Off (#3004, FR-004, #4264). Refused notPermitted from any caller but the person's own clients: never an agent, an MCP tool or a workflow.

methods.name: desktopControl/state
methods.description: Desktop control for this Mac (#3004, #4264): when never set, Ask on a machine a person uses and Always Approve on one only agents use.

methods.name: desktopControl/takeOver
methods.description: Take the screen back from an agent (#3004, US3, FR-008): its screen lease is let go at once, and its drive_screen call answers that the person took over. Refused notHeld when it does not hold the screen lease; refused notPermitted from any caller but the person's own clients.

methods.name: git/fill
methods.description: Asked by the control plane on the lending host's channel 0, for a lend a person allowed (#1122).

methods.name: processes/list
methods.description: The machine's CPU and memory, and the daemon's processes with each session's runtime and its children (#3453). Asked while a machine's page is open; nothing is kept between asks but each process's last CPU time.

methods.name: sandbox/changed
methods.description: The saved command-sandbox defaults (064).

methods.name: sandbox/set
methods.description: Save command-sandbox defaults. A default the catalog does not offer for that runtime is dropped. An agent's own choice is left as it is (064).
